tool_schemas.name: get_user_profile
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated account’s own user profile using the provided account_id, serving cached data unless refresh=true triggers a refetch and cache update; the response is the stored user record for that account context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist locally, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not usable for API access, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream X quota for profile fetches is exhausted (including when refresh=true).

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to use as context for fetching the profile.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh the profile from X instead of using cached data.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_by_screen_name
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a user by screen_name (without @) and returns the locally stored user record, optionally using account_id for authenticated resolution and refresh=true to refetch and update the cache. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if screen_name is empty/invalid or account_id (when provided) is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the user cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if the provided account_id is not permitted/usable for lookups, and RATE_LIMITED when an upstream refresh is required but X rate limits prevent it.

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to use for lookup/refresh context.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh the user from X instead of using cached data.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single user record identified by either user_id (local id) or x_user_id (X id), optionally using account_id as authenticated context and refresh=true to refetch and update cached fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, if both are provided but refer to different users, or if any provided id fails its format checks; raises NOT_FOUND if no matching user exists (or the referenced account_id does not exist), UNAUTHORIZED if the given account_id cannot be used to query X, and RATE_LIMITED if refresh=true triggers an upstream call that exceeds quota.

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to use for lookup/refresh context.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh the user from X instead of using cached data.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_followers
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of follower users for the target specified by user_x_id or screen_name, using account_id as the authenticated context; results are limited by limit (1–200) and advanced with cursor from the prior page, and refresh=true forces rebuilding the follower edges from X before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither user_x_id nor screen_name is provided, if limit is out of range, or if cursor/account_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the target user cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if account_id is not permitted/usable for this graph query, and RATE_LIMITED when refresh=true (or a cache miss) requires upstream calls that exceed quota.

user_x_id.description: X user id (users.x_id) whose followers should be retrieved.

screen_name.description: Screen name whose followers should be retrieved (alternative to user_x_id).

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to use as context for the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh follower edges from X instead of using cached relationships.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_following
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of users the target (user_x_id or screen_name) is following, using account_id as context; results honor limit (1–200) and cursor-based pagination, and refresh=true forces refetch of following edges from X before responding. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid target, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor/account_id; raises NOT_FOUND if the target user cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if account_id is not usable for the request, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream calls are required and X quota is exhausted.

user_x_id.description: X user id (users.x_id) whose following list should be retrieved.

screen_name.description: Screen name whose following list should be retrieved (alternative to user_x_id).

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to use as context for the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh following edges from X instead of using cached relationships.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_followers_you_know
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns a paged list of “common followers” between the provided account_id (“you”) and the target user (user_x_id or screen_name), limited by limit (1–200) and paged with cursor; refresh=true forces refetch of the underlying follower data from X before computing results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the target is missing/invalid, if limit/cursor/account_id is malformed, or if account_id is missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist locally or the target user cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot be used to access the necessary graph data, and RATE_LIMITED if refresh/lookup requires upstream calls that exceed quota.

user_x_id.description: X user id (users.x_id) to compute common followers for.

screen_name.description: Screen name to compute common followers for (alternative to user_x_id).

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id representing 'you' for computing common followers.

limit.description: Maximum number of common followers to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh underlying follower data from X instead of using cached relationships.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_subscriptions
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of users that the target (user_x_id or screen_name) is subscribed to, using account_id as the authenticated context; results use limit (1–200) and cursor for pagination, and refresh=true forces refetch of subscription edges from X before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither user_x_id nor screen_name is provided, if limit is out of range, or if cursor/account_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the target user cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if account_id is not usable for subscription lookups, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream refresh is required but X quota is exhausted.

user_x_id.description: X user id (users.x_id) whose subscriptions should be retrieved.

screen_name.description: Screen name whose subscriptions should be retrieved (alternative to user_x_id).

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to use as context for the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh subscription edges from X instead of using cached relationships.

tool_schemas.name: post_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new tweet as account_id with required text (1–280 chars) and optional reply_to_tweet_x_id, quote_tweet_x_id, media attachments (by media_id with optional alt_text), hashtags, and mentions, returning the created tweet record as stored after posting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid account_id, empty/overlong text, malformed media items, or invalid combinations (e.g., both reply_to_tweet_x_id and quote_tweet_x_id when not supported), NOT_FOUND if a referenced reply/quote tweet or media_id cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if the account cannot post, CONFLICT if posting is refused due to an account/tweet state constraint (e.g., duplicate/blocked action), and RATE_LIMITED if posting exceeds allowed write quota.

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to post the tweet as.

reply_to_tweet_x_id.description: X tweet id to reply to.

media.description: Media attachments to include with the tweet.

alt_text.description: Alt text for the attached media.

tool_schemas.name: delete_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the tweet identified by tweet_id (numeric X id) using account_id as the authenticated context and returns a confirmation of deletion (and updates local storage accordingly). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or tweet_id fails its format requirements, NOT_FOUND if the tweet does not exist or cannot be accessed in this context, UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not permitted to delete the tweet, CONFLICT if the tweet is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to current state, and RATE_LIMITED if the delete request exceeds upstream quota.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when deleting the tweet.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) to delete.

tool_schemas.name: get_tweet_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full stored details for tweet_id (numeric X id) using account_id as the authenticated context, including any locally persisted enrichments available for that tweet. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or tweet_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the tweet cannot be found/resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if the account cannot access the tweet details, and RATE_LIMITED if fetching requires upstream calls and X quota is exhausted.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when fetching tweet details.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) to fetch details for.

tool_schemas.name: create_poll_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new tweet for the given authenticated account and attaches a poll with 2–4 choices and the provided duration, returning the created tweet record (including its X/Twitter tweet ID) and poll metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is not a valid authenticated context, if choices is not 2–4 items, or if duration_minutes is < 1 (or any required field is missing). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if posting is rate-limited, and CONFLICT if the tweet cannot be created in the current account state.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when creating the tweet.

text.description: Tweet text to post along with the poll.

tool_schemas.name: vote_on_poll
tool_schemas.description: Casts a vote on the poll contained in the specified tweet on behalf of the authenticated account and returns the updated poll state as observed after voting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if choice_index is negative or required fields are missing, NOT_FOUND if tweet_id does not exist or does not reference a tweet with a poll, and CONFLICT if the vote is not allowed (e.g., poll is closed or the account has already voted and revoting is not supported). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if voting is rate-limited.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when voting on the poll.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) containing the poll to vote on.

choice_index.description: Zero-based index of the poll choice to vote for.

tool_schemas.name: favorite_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Favorites (likes) the specified tweet on behalf of the authenticated account and returns the resulting favorite state for that tweet. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed, NOT_FOUND if tweet_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the tweet cannot be favorited in its current state (for example, already favorited when duplicates are not accepted). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the action is rate-limited.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when favoriting the tweet.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) to favorite.

tool_schemas.name: unfavorite_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Removes the authenticated account’s favorite (like) from the specified tweet and returns the resulting favorite state for that tweet. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed, NOT_FOUND if tweet_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if there is no existing favorite to remove or the tweet cannot transition to an unfavorited state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the action is rate-limited.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when removing the favorite.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) to unfavorite.

tool_schemas.name: bookmark_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified tweet to the authenticated account’s bookmarks and returns the resulting bookmark state for that tweet. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed and NOT_FOUND if tweet_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if bookmarking is rate-limited, and CONFLICT if the tweet is already bookmarked and duplicates are not accepted.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when bookmarking the tweet.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) to bookmark.

tool_schemas.name: delete_bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified tweet from the authenticated account’s bookmarks and returns the resulting bookmark state for that tweet. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed and NOT_FOUND if tweet_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the operation is rate-limited, and CONFLICT if the tweet is not currently bookmarked.

account_id.description: Authenticated account context to use when removing the bookmark.

tweet_id.description: The X/Twitter tweet ID (x_id) to remove from bookmarks.

tool_schemas.name: delete_all_bookmarks
tool_schemas.description: Deletes all bookmarks for the authenticated account and returns a summary of the deletion (for example, how many bookmarks were removed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed or missing and UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot act. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the operation is rate-limited and CONFLICT if bookmarks cannot be cleared in the current account state.

account_id.description: Authenticated account to delete bookmarks for.

tool_schemas.name: get_timeline
tool_schemas.description: Returns tweets from the authenticated account’s home timeline (For You), up to limit items, and includes a cursor for pagination; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and set refresh=true to fetch and persist a refreshed view. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is outside 1–200 or parameters are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot access timelines, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if fetching/refreshing is rate-limited, and NOT_FOUND if the account context does not exist.

account_id.description: Authenticated account whose home timeline (For You) is fetched.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue from a previous timeline response.

refresh.description: If true, fetches from X and refreshes cached feed data; if false, may serve cached results.

tool_schemas.name: get_latest_timeline
tool_schemas.description: Returns tweets from the authenticated account’s home timeline (Following), up to limit items, and includes a cursor for pagination; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and set refresh=true to fetch and persist a refreshed view. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is outside 1–200 or parameters are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot access timelines, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if fetching/refreshing is rate-limited, and NOT_FOUND if the account context does not exist.

account_id.description: Authenticated account whose home timeline (Following) is fetched.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue from a previous timeline response.

refresh.description: If true, fetches from X and refreshes cached feed data; if false, may serve cached results.

tool_schemas.name: search_twitter
tool_schemas.description: Executes a tweet search for the given query under the authenticated account context, returning up to limit results and a cursor for pagination; pass the returned cursor to continue the same query, and set refresh=true to fetch and persist a refreshed result set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty, limit is outside 1–200, or parameters are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account context cannot perform searches, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if searching/refreshing is rate-limited, and NOT_FOUND if the account context does not exist.

account_id.description: Authenticated account to execute the search under.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue from a previous search response.

refresh.description: If true, fetches from X and refreshes cached search data; if false, may serve cached results.

tool_schemas.name: get_trends
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current trending topics visible to the authenticated account, returning up to `limit` items and a `cursor` for pagination when more results are available; if `refresh` is false, results may be served from cached trends for that account/context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `account_id` is malformed, `limit` is outside 1–100, or an unknown `cursor` is provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated/accessible to the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced account does not exist and RATE_LIMITED if fetching/refreshing trends exceeds configured rate limits for the account or service.

account_id.description: Authenticated account to retrieve trends for.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending topics to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue from a previous trends response.

refresh.description: If true, fetches from X and refreshes cached trends data; if false, may serve cached results.

tool_schemas.name: get_highlights_tweets
tool_schemas.description: Returns highlighted tweets for the specified `user_x_id` as viewed under the authenticated `account_id`, returning up to `limit` tweets and a `cursor` for pagination; if `refresh` is false, the service may return cached highlights. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are missing/invalid, `limit` is outside 1–200, or the `cursor` is invalid for this query; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot act as `account_id`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account or target user is unknown and RATE_LIMITED if a refresh requires upstream access beyond allowed quotas.

account_id.description: Authenticated account to retrieve highlights under.

user_x_id.description: X user id whose highlighted tweets are retrieved.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue from a previous highlights response.

refresh.description: If true, fetches from X and refreshes cached highlights data; if false, may serve cached results.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_mentions
tool_schemas.description: Lists tweets that mention the specified `user_x_id` in the context of the authenticated `account_id`, returning up to `limit` tweets and a `cursor` for pagination; if `refresh` is false, results may be served from cached mention timelines. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are invalid, `limit` is outside 1–200, or the `cursor` is invalid/out of scope for the query; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use `account_id`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account or mentioned user does not exist and RATE_LIMITED when refreshing mentions would exceed rate limits.

account_id.description: Authenticated account to retrieve mentions under.

user_x_id.description: X user id being mentioned in the returned tweets.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue from a previous mentions response.

refresh.description: If true, fetches from X and refreshes cached mentions data; if false, may serve cached results.

tool_schemas.name: list_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally stored authenticated accounts with optional status filtering and cursor pagination. Returns account records (excluding stored secrets when redaction is enabled) ordered by most recently updated. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/limits and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to enumerate accounts.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

include_secrets.description: Whether to include stored credentials (access_token/refresh_token/cookie_jar) in the returned records; defaults to false and may be refused for non-privileged callers.

tool_schemas.name: create_account
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new authenticated account context by storing provided X credentials and initializing rate-limit tracking. Returns the created accounts record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed credentials, CONFLICT if an account for the same x_user_id already exists (unless replace=true), and UNAUTHORIZED if the credential cannot be validated against X.

x_user_id.description: X user id the credential belongs to (if known); if omitted the service will resolve it during validation.

screen_name.description: Account handle (without @) for display and uniqueness checks; if omitted the service will resolve it during validation.

display_name.description: Display name to store for the account; optional and may be overwritten by validation.

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token (optional depending on upstream flow).

token_expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the access token if known.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status; defaults to active after successful validation.

replace.description: If true and an account already exists for the resolved x_user_id, update it in place instead of raising CONFLICT.

tool_schemas.name: update_account
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing account record, including driving allowed lifecycle state transitions (status) and rotating credentials. Returns the updated account record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions or malformed fields, NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if activating/rotating credentials fails validation against X.

account_id.description: Local authenticated account id to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status; must be a permitted transition from the current status.

access_token.description: Replace OAuth access token (oauth2 accounts only).

refresh_token.description: Replace OAuth refresh token (oauth2 accounts only).

cookie_jar.description: Replace serialized cookie jar (cookie accounts only).

rate_limit_state.description: Optional server-side override/restore of rate limit state blob for this account.

validate.description: Whether to validate the updated credentials with X before persisting; defaults to true when credentials/status are changed.

tool_schemas.name: list_tweets
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally stored tweets with filtering and cursor pagination. Returns tweet records as cached, including status. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/limits and UNAUTHORIZED if an authenticated context is required for the requested filters.

account_id.description: Optional account context; used when filtering by author relationship or when protected content requires authorization.

author_user_x_id.description: Filter tweets authored by this X user id.

conversation_x_id.description: Filter tweets belonging to a conversation.

since.description: Only return tweets created on X at or after this time.

until.description: Only return tweets created on X before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: set_tweet_status
tool_schemas.description: Drives a tweet lifecycle status transition in the local store (e.g., marking withheld/tombstoned after upstream signals) without posting to X. Returns the updated tweet record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions, NOT_FOUND if the tweet cannot be located, and CONFLICT if the update would incorrectly resurrect a deleted tweet without explicit allow_resurrect=true.

x_tweet_id.description: X tweet id (tweets.x_id) to update (alternative to tweet_id).

status.description: New tweet status; must be a permitted transition from current status.

deleted_on_x_at.description: When marking deleted, set the deletion timestamp from X.

allow_resurrect.description: If true, allows changing status from deleted back to visible when explicitly confirmed by X.

reason.description: Optional audit note describing why the status was changed.

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlement context, including active account (if any), granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption snapshot. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated.

account_id.description: Optional account to inspect; if omitted, returns the server’s current/default active account context if configured.

metadata.name: X Twitter Server
metadata.description: This backend stores local representations of X/Twitter users and tweets plus the authenticated account context used by the MCP server to act on behalf of a user. It records social graph edges (follow/subscription), tweet interactions (favorites/likes, bookmarks, poll votes), and also persists read-s
